This notebook will combine predicted species sensitivity with species
information (taxonomy, phylogeny, body mass, and functional groups) for
further analysis.

This notebook will also read chemical group information collected from
PPDB database and filter the combined dataset to selected chemicals with
known pesticide types.

Hence, combined dataset and sub dataset for selected chemicals will be
saved in the end.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(here)
library(tidyverse)  
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)

options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
```

# 1. Read species dataset

Read species's dataset

```{r}
spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG <- readRDS(here("data/6_combined/spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG.rds")) %>%
    mutate(log_mass = log10(mean_mass_g)) 

```

Calculate centered species' body masses:

```{r}
spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG  <- spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG %>% mutate(log_mass_c = scale(log_mass, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)[,1])
```

# 2. Filter predicted sensitivity dataset

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load the prediction dataset
#predicted_sensitivity <- read_csv(here("data/2_predicted_sensitivity/predictions.csv"))
#predicitons_ML_duration24h <- predicted_sensitivity %>% filter(duration ==24)
predicitons_ML_duration24h <- readRDS(here("data/2_predicted_sensitivity/predicitons_ML_duration24h.rds"))

# correct species names
predicted_sensitivity <- predicitons_ML_duration24h %>%
  mutate(latin = species) %>%
  mutate(
    latin = case_when(
      latin == "lithodes antarcticus" ~ "lithodes antarctica",
      latin == "Viviparus bengalensis" ~ "filopaludina bengalensis",
      latin == "acanthomysis sculpta" ~ "holmesimysis sculpta",
      latin == "acartia clausi" ~ "acartia clausii",
      latin == "acartia lillgeborgi" ~ "acartia lilljeborgii",
      latin == "acheilognathus moriokae" ~ "acheilognathus melanogaster",
      latin == "achnanthes minutissima" ~ "achnanthidium minutissimum",
      latin == "nuria danrica" ~ "esomus danrica",
      latin == "oreochromis mossambicus x urolepis" ~ "oreochromis mossambicus",
      latin == "oreochromis mossambicus x niloticus" ~ "oreochromis mossambicus", 
      latin == "enteromorpha intestinalis" ~ "ulva intestinalis", 
      TRUE ~ latin   
    )
  ) %>% distinct()

# only keep latin with avaialable traits
# since 2 species share the same latin
dt <- as.data.table(predicted_sensitivity)
predicted_sensitivity_filter <- dt[
  latin %in% spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG$latin,
  .(
    predicted = mean(predicted, na.rm = TRUE),
    species = first(species)
  ),
  by = .(latin, CAS, duration)
]

length(unique(predicted_sensitivity_filter$latin)) # should be 906

```

# 3. Combine species predicted sensitivity with traits

We integrate all trait information (taxonomy, phylogeny, body mass, and
functional groups) with the predicted sensitivity values.

```{r}
spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi <- left_join(predicted_sensitivity_filter, spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG, by = "latin")

# rename the dataset columns
spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi <- spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi %>%
  mutate(
    sensi = 10^predicted,
    CAS = as.factor(CAS),
    duration = as.factor(duration)
  ) %>% rename(log_sensi = predicted)

# dataset summary
length(unique(spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi$CAS))

length(unique(spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi$latin))

unique(spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi$FG2)

```

Different groupings of functional groups:

```{r}
spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi <- spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi %>%
  mutate(
    .g  = str_to_lower(group),

    # FG3: add I_/V_ prefixes by group
    FG3 = case_when(
      .g == "algae"        ~ FG2,
      .g == "invertebrate" ~ paste0("I_", FG2),
      .g == "vertebrate"   ~ paste0("V_", FG2),
      TRUE                 ~ FG2
    ),

    # normalize commas for later splitting
    FG4 = str_replace_all(FG3, "\\s*,\\s*", ",")
  ) %>%
  # FG4: one value per row
  separate_rows(FG4, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(
    FG4 = str_trim(FG4),
    # ensure I_ prefix remains after splitting
    FG4 = if_else(.g == "invertebrate" & !str_starts(FG4, "I_"),
                  paste0("I_", FG4), FG4),
    FG4 = str_replace_all(FG4, "\\s*/\\s*", "_"),
    FG4 = str_squish(FG4),
    # recode specific cases
    FG4 = if_else(FG4 %in% c("V_Detritivore_Herbivore", "V_Herbivore", "V_Detritivore"), "V_Detritivore_Herbivore", FG4),

    # FG5: arthropods get "_A"
    FG5 = if_else(phylum == "arthropoda", paste0(FG4, "_A"), FG4)
  ) %>%
  select(-.g) %>%
  distinct()


# dataset summary
length(unique(spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi$CAS))

length(unique(spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi$latin))

unique(spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi$FG3)

unique(spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi$FG4)

unique(spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi$FG5)
```

Calculate species relative sensitivity: Given the large variation across
chemical toxicity effects, we calculate the species relative sensitivty
for each chemical using the reference species *Daphina manga*, that is,
for each chemical, we divided species sensitivity by the reference
species sensitivity, and the use the log 10 ratio to represent the
species relative sensitivity.

```{r}
spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi <- spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi %>%
  group_by(CAS, duration) %>%
  mutate(
    ref_sensi = sensi[latin == "daphnia magna"],  # D. magna as reference
    rel_sensi = sensi / ref_sensi,
    log_rel_sensi = log10(rel_sensi)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(log_mass), !is.na(log_rel_sensi), is.finite(log_rel_sensi))
```

# 4. Read chemical group information and filter to selected chemicals

Filter to selected chemicals based on
<https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-023-02904-7> and PPDB chemical pesticide
types.\
- Broad chemical groups: Pesticide; Industrial Chemicals; Pharmaceuticals.
- Sub groups under Pesticide:

```{r}
# Read gathered chemical groups
chem_groups_source <- read_csv(file=here("data/6_combined/chem_groups.csv")) 

convert_ddmmyyyy_to_cas <- function(x) {
  # keep only entries that look like dd/mm/yyyy
  if (!str_detect(x, "^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$")) {
    return(x)
  }
  
  parts <- str_split(x, "/", simplify = TRUE)
  day   <- parts[, 1]
  month <- parts[, 2]
  year  <- parts[, 3]
  
  paste0(year, "-", month, "-", day)
}

chem_groups_source <- chem_groups_source %>%
  mutate(
    CAS = if_else(
      str_detect(CAS, "^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$"),
      format(as.Date(CAS, format = "%d/%m/%Y"), "%Y-%m-%d"),
      CAS
    )
  )

chem_groups_source <- chem_groups_source %>%
  mutate(CAS = str_squish(CAS),
         broad_group = str_squish(use_group),
         p_sub_group = str_squish(Pesticide_sub_group)) %>%
  select(CAS, broad_group, p_sub_group) %>%
  filter(! is.na(broad_group)) %>%
  filter(! broad_group == "Metal")

unique(chem_groups_source$broad_group) # "Industrial Chemical" "Pesticide"           "Pharmaceutical" 

```

Clean and map PPDB pesticide types to final chemical groups
```{r}
unique(chem_groups_source$p_sub_group)
tag_to_group <- c(
  # Arthropod control
  "Insecticide"               = "arthropod-control",
  "Acaricide"                 = "arthropod-control",
  "Miticide"                  = "arthropod-control",
  "Larvicide"                 = "arthropod-control",
  "Termiticide"               = "arthropod-control",
  "Insect Growth Regulator"   = "arthropod-control",
  
  # Plant control
  "Herbicide"                     = "plant-control",
  "Plant Growth Regulator"        = "plant-control",
  "Plant Growth Regulator precursor" = "plant-control",
  "Desiccant"                     = "plant-control",
  "Defoliant"                     = "plant-control",
  "Graminicide"                   = "plant-control",
  
  # Microorganism control
  "Fungicide"       = "microbial-control",
  "Microbiocide"    = "microbial-control",
  "Algicide"        = "microbial-control",
  "bacteria"        = "microbial-control",
  "bacteria, fungi" = "microbial-control",
  
  # Nematode control
  "Nematicide" = "nematode-control",
  
  # Mollusc control
  "Molluscicide" = "mollusc-control",
  
  # Vertebrate control
  "Rodenticide" = "vertebrate-control",
  "Avicide"     = "vertebrate-control",
  "Piscicide"   = "vertebrate-control",
  "Lampricide"  = "vertebrate-control",
  
  # Veterinary antiparasitic / drug
  "Veterinary substance" = "veterinary-drug",
  "Crop antibiotic"      = "veterinary-drug",
  
  # Repellent / chemical signals
  "Repellent"     = "repellent-signal",
  "Semiochemical" = "repellent-signal",
  "Attractant"    = "repellent-signal",
  
  # Fumigant / soil sterilant
  "Fumigant"       = "fumigant-soil-sterilant",
  "Soil sterilant" = "fumigant-soil-sterilant",
  
  # Auxiliary (only used if no other group present)
  "Metabolite" = "auxiliary",
  "Adjuvant"   = "auxiliary"
  
  # Note: "Other substance" is intentionally NOT mapped
)

map_subgroup_to_target <- function(x, tag_to_group) {
  # NA or empty
  if (is.na(x) || str_squish(x) == "") return(NA_character_)
  
  # Split on ";" only (keep "bacteria, fungi" together)
  tags <- str_split(x, pattern = ";", simplify = FALSE)[[1]]
  tags <- str_squish(tags)
  
  # Drop explicit "Other substance" (ignored by design)
  tags <- tags[tags != "Other substance"]
  
  # Shortcut: original label "Mixed"
  if (length(tags) == 1 && identical(tags, "Mixed")) {
    return("mixed-target")
  }
  
  # Map tags to groups; ignore unrecognised tags
  groups_all <- unique(na.omit(tag_to_group[tags]))
  
  # Separate "auxiliary" from true target-control groups
  main_groups <- setdiff(groups_all, "auxiliary")
  has_auxiliary <- "auxiliary" %in% groups_all
  
  # Decision rules:
  if (length(main_groups) == 0 && !has_auxiliary) {
    # No target-control info (e.g. only unknown tags removed as Other substance)
    return(NA_character_)
  } else if (length(main_groups) == 0 && has_auxiliary) {
    # Only auxiliary info (e.g. Metabolite alone)
    return("auxiliary")
  } else if (length(main_groups) == 1) {
    # Single clear target-control group
    return(main_groups)
  } else {
    # Multiple target-control groups
    return("mixed-target")
  }
}

chem_groups_source <- chem_groups_source %>%
  mutate(
    # Fix obvious typos first
    p_sub_group = str_replace_all(p_sub_group, "Insectiicde", "Insecticide"),
    
    # Apply mapping function
    p_target_group = map_chr(p_sub_group, map_subgroup_to_target, tag_to_group = tag_to_group)
  )

table(chem_groups_source$p_target_group, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
# clean and filter out unknown pesticide types
keep_pesticide <- chem_groups_source %>%
  filter(broad_group == "Pesticide") %>%
  filter(p_target_group %in% c("arthropod-control", "microbial-control", 
                               "plant-control", "mixed-target")) %>%
  pull(CAS)
chem_groups_source <- chem_groups_source %>%
  filter(broad_group != "Pesticide" | CAS %in% keep_pesticide)

unique(chem_groups_source$broad_group)
unique(chem_groups_source$p_target_group)

# make a final group list, which are Industrial Chemical, Pharmaceutical, arthropod-control, microorganism-control, plant-control, mixed-target
chem_groups_source <- chem_groups_source %>% mutate(
  final_group = case_when(
    broad_group == "Industrial Chemical" ~ "Industrial_Chemical",
    broad_group == "Pharmaceutical"       ~ "Pharmaceutical",
    p_target_group == "arthropod-control" ~ "P_Arthropod_control",
    p_target_group == "microbial-control" ~ "P_Microbial_control",
    p_target_group == "plant-control"     ~ "P_Plant_control",
    p_target_group == "mixed-target"      ~ "P_Mixed_target",
    TRUE                                 ~ NA_character_
  ) )

count(chem_groups_source, final_group)
length(unique(chem_groups_source$CAS))  #1103
```


# 5. Save outputs

## 5.1 Whole dataset with 906 species and 3297 chemicals

```{r}
# save the combined data
saveRDS(spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi, file=here("data/6_combined/spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi.rds"))

```

## 5.2 Sub-dataset with 906 species and selected 999 chemicals

```{r}
# filter the whole dataset to selected *1103* chemicals
spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS <- spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi %>%
  inner_join(chem_groups_source %>% select(CAS, final_group),
             by = "CAS") %>%
  rename(chem_group = final_group)

# dataset summary
length(unique(spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS$CAS))
length(unique(spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS$latin))
unique(spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS$chem_group)

saveRDS(spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS, file=here("data/6_combined/spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS.rds"))

```

Quick look

```{r}
plotdf <- spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS %>% filter(duration == "24")
trophic_order <- c(
  "Cyanobacteria", "Diatom", "Green algae",  "Other algae",        # producers
  "I_Shredder_A", "I_Filterer_A", "I_Gatherer_A", "I_Predator_A", "I_Herbivore_A",
  "I_Herbivore", "I_Filterer", "I_Gatherer",  "I_Predator",  # grazers
  "V_Detritivore_Herbivore", "V_Planktivore", "V_Invertivore", "V_Omnivore", "V_Piscivore" )

plotdf <- plotdf %>%
  mutate(FG5 = factor(FG5, levels = trophic_order))

chem_group_quicklook <- ggplot(plotdf, 
                               aes(x = log_mass_c, y = log_rel_sensi, 
                                   col = chem_group, group = chem_group))+
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth(method = lm, se = FALSE, color="black") +
  facet_grid(chem_group ~ FG5, scale = "free_x") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  labs(
    x = "Centered log10 body mass",
    y = "log10 relative sensitivity",
    col = "Chemical group") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

chem_group_quicklook

```
